summary: Iteration 27 — Verified strict RBAC (route + API), role-aware CEO Brief (owner company-wide vs employee personal), employee AI Coach entry point, and company-profile dialog moved to top-bar. BACKEND (30/30 pytest passed in 4.70s / test_iteration27.py): auth (owner/prod login + /auth/me role); RBAC (production → 403 on /operating-score & /invoices, 200 on /brain/search; owner → 200 on all); /brief shape (owner returns role='owner' + counters {delayed,completed,awaiting_approval,absent,complaints,payment_overdue,fires}; production returns role='production' + counters {delayed,todo,in_progress,completed,escalations,handoffs} with NO owner-only keys); /brief/details owner-only keys (awaiting_approval/absent/complaints/payment_overdue/fires) return {items:[], actionable:false} for employee; personal keys return proper shape for employee; owner-only key /brief/details?key=fires returns proper shape; PATCH /tenant works for owner (added TEST_iter27_product then restored) and returns 403 for production; POST /ingest/csv returns 403 for production. FRONTEND (Playwright): OWNER (owner@sharma.com) — all 8 sidebar menus (nav-inbox, nav-ceo-brief, nav-ingest, nav-workflows, nav-contacts, nav-my-work, nav-meetings, nav-brain) VISIBLE; company-profile-button visible; CEO Brief shows brief-open-journal button, NO brief-open-coach, all 6 company counters visible (fires banner absent — 0 fires currently, matches backend); inbox-operating-score-button navigates without access-denied; Company dialog opens (company-dialog, company-save-button, company-add-product); people-tabs, brain-tab-ask, brain-tab-search, work-view-mywork, work-view-board, ai-priority-toggle all visible. EMPLOYEE (production@sharma.com) — sidebar shows all 7 allowed items and CORRECTLY hides nav-ingest; direct /operating-score renders access-denied with access-denied-home button that navigates to /my-work; CEO Brief title is 'My Brief', shows brief-open-coach (NOT brief-open-journal), NO fires banner, personal counters {delayed,todo,in_progress,completed,escalations,handoffs} all visible, owner-only counters ALL correctly absent; clicking brief-open-coach navigates to /coach and renders coach-summary + coach-refresh-btn (NO access-denied); clicking brief-row-delayed opens brief-detail-dialog-delayed; direct /ingest renders access-denied. Zero console errors. Every acceptance criterion listed in the review request passes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2261-2316 GET /brief — clean role branch. Owner counters ({delayed,completed,awaiting_approval,absent,complaints,payment_overdue,fires}) vs non-owner personal counters ({delayed,todo,in_progress,completed,escalations,handoffs}) with `mine = {$or: [{assignee_id: user.id},{assignee_role: user.role}]}` scoping. The `completed` counter for non-owner is scoped by `activity.actor == user.id`, which is the right choice (matches 'my completions'). Response also returns `role` so the frontend renders the correct row set from a single source of truth.

server.py:2341-2342 GET /brief/details — the `owner-only keys → empty` guard is one line and returns {actionable:false, items:[]} which the DetailDialog renders as 'Nothing here right now.' — correct silent-block UX so the endpoint can be reused by both roles without leaking counts.

App.js:42-53 Protected component — clean 2-branch gate (ownerOnly XOR perm) rendered INSIDE Layout so the AccessDenied screen keeps the sidebar/topbar for context and lets the user pivot; access-denied-home routes to /my-work (a page every role can reach). Nice consistent UX.

Layout.js:35-42 NAV — perm filtering is done in useMemo and correctly leaves out `nav-ingest` for production. Operating Score is NOT in the sidebar (only reachable via Decision Desk's inbox-operating-score-button, which is the correct discoverability path since Op Score is owner-only).

CEOBrief.js:170 & 181-192 — `isOwner ? ROWS : EMP_ROWS` and the header dual-button (CEO Journal vs AI Coach) are keyed off `user.role`, and the counter/detail queries use the same `role` implicitly via the backend. Note: rows are chosen from `useAuth().user.role` while data comes from the /brief `role` field — no risk of mismatch in practice because /auth/me is the source of truth for user.role at login and /brief re-reads it server-side, but a small future improvement could be to render rows off `data.role` (server-of-record) instead of the client cache. Non-blocking.

server.py:110-124 permission model — production role falls back to `_BASE_PERMS = {inbox,people,workflows,tasks,brain,ask}` (no data_input, no finance, no team_manage), which matches the observed 403s on /ingest/csv, /invoices, /tenant and 200s on /brain/search. Consistent.

server.py:2419-2424 — the `fires` counter/detail is scoped only by `source=='escalation'` (not by handoff), which is the correct semantic ('fires' = escalations only) and aligns with the Iter26 fix that discriminates source at insert time.
server.py:2274 `is_owner = user['role'] == 'owner'` is used consistently in both /brief and /brief/details — single check, no drift.

CompanyDialog.js — save-button gated by `canManage` (team_manage perm). Employees cannot open the dialog because company-profile-button is only rendered in the top bar for users with team_manage, keeping the surface consistent with the backend PATCH /tenant guard. Well-composed.
Nice-to-have carry-forward: server.py is ~3390 lines; iter25's suggestion to split into routers still stands. Not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter27 covers RBAC + role-aware CEO Brief + AI Coach entry + top-bar company dialog. Rerun backend: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration27.py -o addopts= -v` — expect 30 pass in ~5s. Key facts for the next agent: (1) production role has _BASE_PERMS = {inbox,people,workflows,tasks,brain,ask} — so production CAN read /api/contacts (200) and /api/brain/search (200) but CANNOT ingest, finance, team_manage, and CANNOT access owner-only (/operating-score, journal, decisions/approve, voice/text capture). (2) /api/brief response includes `role` so the frontend picks EMP_ROWS vs ROWS from a single field. (3) /api/brief/details for non-owner: owner-only keys always return {items:[], actionable:false}; personal keys scope by assignee_id OR assignee_role. (4) The `fires` counter/banner is owner-only and displayed only when count>0 (currently 0 in demo, so banner absent — that's expected, not a bug). (5) Frontend testids used: nav-* (sidebar items — including nav-my-work which has no perm, always visible), brief-open-journal (owner) / brief-open-coach (employee), brief-count-<key>, brief-row-<key>, brief-row-fires (owner only, count>0 only), brief-detail-dialog-<key>, access-denied, access-denied-home, company-profile-button, company-dialog, company-save-button, company-add-product, people-tabs, brain-tab-ask, brain-tab-search, work-view-mywork, work-view-board, ai-priority-toggle, inbox-operating-score-button, coach-summary/coach-refresh-btn. (6) /coach is a Protected route WITHOUT ownerOnly or perm — every logged-in user can access their own coach; the WorkCoach page renders per-user stats/strengths/improvements from GET /api/coach/summary (assumed endpoint). (7) The '/api/tenant' PATCH is gated by team_manage (owner only). (8) Direct /ingest and /operating-score correctly render Access Denied inside Layout, preserving sidebar so the user can pivot.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature-verification pass. All 12 acceptance criteria in the review request pass end-to-end: RBAC guards at route (Protected/AccessDenied) AND API (require_perm/require_role) layers are correctly wired; role-aware /brief branches produce the right counter set per role; DetailDialog reuses a single endpoint and the backend silently empties owner-only keys for non-owner; /coach is universally accessible so employees have an actionable next step from their My Brief; and the top-bar Company Dialog is properly gated by team_manage. No bugs found; no regressions in adjacent features.
